_meta.purpose: The rules that move a walker row with no Fill row out of `unassessed` (FR-48-65, register S6/D3). Each names a measuring artefact the walker raises, not a verdict on a setting: a box measurement that follows layout rows (or has no explaining row, `box-unexplained`), and a difference in how the draft and the block make a motion (compared by what they paint, not by how they are made). lib/census-unassessed.mjs reads it.
_meta.layoutKeys: The style keys that move a box: the same set lib/triage.mjs reads for a box row (LAYOUT_KEY).
